mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (user_id, category, title, content, upvote_count, downvote_count, comment_count) VALUES (#{userId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, 0, 0, 0)

where.if: AND (title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select:
SELECT post_id, user_id, category, title, content, upvote_count, downvote_count, comment_count, created_at, updated_at FROM post
ORDER BY upvote_count DESC, created_at DESC
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT #{pagination.limit} OFFSET #{pagination.offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET category = #{category}, title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE post_id = #{postId}
